Fat Loss Meal Plan ​

Daily Calorie Target: 2,100 calories
Goal: Reduce body fat from 30% to 17%

Daily Meal Plans ​

Calorie Breakdown ​

Breakfast Options ​

450-500 calories per serving

Option 1 - Quick Eggs & Yogurt

  • 3 scrambled eggs (210 cal)
  • Coles high protein yogurt (80 cal)
  • 1 cup frozen berries (80 cal)
  • Small handful nuts (80 cal)

Option 2 - Protein Smoothie

  • WPI/WPC protein shake (150 cal)
  • 1 banana (100 cal)
  • 1 cup berries (80 cal)
  • 2 slices toast (160 cal)

Option 3 - Overnight Oats

  • 1/2 cup oats + protein powder (300 cal)
  • Greek yogurt (100 cal)
  • Berries (80 cal)

Lunch Options ​

600-650 calories per serving

Option 1 - Hainanese Chicken Rice

  • 150g hainanese chicken (300 cal)
  • 3/4 cup cooked rice (200 cal)
  • Steamed vegetables (80 cal)
  • Light sauce/ginger scallion (70 cal)

Option 2 - Tuna Pasta

  • 1 can tuna (150 cal)
  • 100g cooked pasta (220 cal)
  • Jar sauce (100 cal)
  • Frozen vegetables (80 cal)
  • Small drizzle olive oil (100 cal)

Option 3 - Chicken Pasta Salad

  • 120g cooked chicken (250 cal)
  • 80g cooked pasta (180 cal)
  • Mixed vegetables (80 cal)
  • Light dressing (140 cal)

Dinner Options ​

550-600 calories per serving

Option 1 - Air-fried Chicken

  • 150g Portuguese seasoned chicken (300 cal)
  • 1 large microwaved sweet potato (200 cal)
  • Bagged salad with olive oil (100 cal)

Option 2 - Rice Cooker One-Pot

  • 120g chicken (250 cal)
  • 1/2 cup rice (150 cal)
  • Mixed vegetables (80 cal)
  • Sauce/seasonings (70 cal)

Option 3 - Simple Stir-fry

  • 120g chicken (250 cal)
  • 100g pasta (220 cal)
  • Frozen stir-fry vegetables (80 cal)
  • Minimal oil/sauce (50 cal)

Snack Options ​

350-400 calories per serving

Daily Snack Combination:

  • WPI/WPC protein shake (150 cal)
  • Measured cereal portion (200 cal)

Alternative Snack Options:

  • 2 hard-boiled eggs + apple (200 cal)
  • Greek yogurt + nuts (200 cal)
  • Protein bar + banana (300 cal)

Meal Prep Strategy ​

Sunday Prep Session ​

Rice Cooker Hainanese Chicken:

  • 1.5-2kg chicken thighs
  • Ginger slices (smashed, not chopped)
  • Garlic cloves (smashed)
  • Soy sauce, sesame oil, rice wine
  • Cook with minimal water - chicken creates broth
  • Save cooking liquid for rice

Additional Prep:

  • Hard-boil 8-10 eggs
  • Cook bulk pasta (500g)
  • Wash and portion berries
  • Pre-measure cereal portions

Mid-Week Prep (Wednesday) ​

Air Fryer Portuguese Chicken:

  • 1kg chicken thighs
  • Portuguese seasoning
  • Air fry at 200°C for 25-30 minutes
  • Portion into containers

Daily Tasks ​

  • Scramble eggs for breakfast (2 minutes)
  • Microwave sweet potatoes as needed
  • Steam frozen vegetables
  • Grab pre-portioned meals

Equipment Guide ​

Rice Cooker (1.8L) ​

  • Hainanese chicken + rice together
  • Steam vegetables using steamer basket
  • Hard-boil eggs on top while cooking
  • One-pot pasta meals

Air Fryer ​

  • Batch cook seasoned chicken thighs
  • Reheat pre-cooked proteins
  • Quick vegetable cooking

Stove ​

  • Daily egg scrambling
  • Pasta cooking
  • Quick stir-fries

Protein Sources & Prep Methods ​

Primary Proteins ​

  1. Hainanese Chicken (rice cooker method)
  2. Portuguese Chicken (air fryer method)
  3. Canned Tuna (no prep required)
  4. Eggs (hard-boiled batch, daily scrambled)
  5. WPI/WPC Protein Shakes

Seasoning Rotation ​

  • Cajun spice blend
  • Italian herb mix
  • Garlic powder + paprika + salt
  • Lemon pepper
  • Tandoori spice blend

Cardio Integration ​

Integration with Workout Plan

This cardio plan is designed to complement the Workout Plan. See the workout plan for detailed gym sessions.

Starting Phase (Weeks 1-2) ​

  • Frequency: 2 sessions per week (Tuesday + weekend)
  • Duration: 20-25 minutes
  • Intensity: Incline walking (3-4% grade, brisk pace)

Progression (Every 2 weeks) ​

  • Add 5 minutes to sessions
  • Target: 35-40 minutes before adding intensity
  • Eventually add light jogging intervals

Integration with Current Routine ​

  • Tuesday: Cardio (office day)
  • Current schedule maintained
  • Weekend cardio session flexible timing

Nutrition Tracking ​

Recommended Apps & Tools ​

  • Flexify: Track all gym sessions and progressive overload
  • MyFitnessPal / Cronometer: Calorie and macro tracking
  • Body weight app: Daily weigh-ins with trend analysis
  • Food scale: Accurate portion measurement

Daily Tracking ​

  • Log all meals and snacks
  • Use food scale for accuracy
  • Aim for 2,100 calories daily
  • Target ~140g protein daily
  • Record gym performance in Flexify

Weekly Check-ins ​

  • Body weight trends (not daily fluctuations)
  • Progress photos (same lighting/pose)
  • How clothes fit
  • Energy levels and workout performance

Monthly Assessments ​

  • Body fat measurements (if possible)
  • Workout progression review
  • Diet adherence analysis
  • Adjust calories if needed

Supplements & Recovery ​

Supplements Worth Considering ​

Effective & Evidence-Based:

  • Creatine Monohydrate: 3-5g daily, improves strength training performance (~$15/month)
  • Caffeine: Pre-workout if tolerated well (basically free)
  • WPI/WPC Protein: Already planned for post-workout

Questionable Value:

  • Magnesium: Minimal direct fat loss benefits, only consider if experiencing muscle cramps or sleep issues
  • BCAAs: Unnecessary with adequate protein intake
  • Recovery drinks: Overpriced marketing

Recovery Strategies (Free & Effective) ​

The Big 3 (Most Impactful):

  1. Sleep: 7-9 hours consistently - beats any supplement
  2. Protein timing: Post-workout shakes (already planned)
  3. Hydration: 3-4L daily, more on tennis/climbing days

Low-Cost, High-Impact:

  • Hot/cold therapy: Hot shower followed by 30-60 seconds cold water
  • Light movement: 10-15 min walks on rest days
  • Stretching: Follow your current flexibility plan religiously
  • Foam rolling: $15 foam roller for forearms (tennis elbow prevention)

Tennis/Climbing Specific:

  • Wrist stretches (already in Thursday routine)
  • Proper warm-ups (covered in current plan)
  • Forearm foam rolling

Success Strategies ​

Hydration Strategy ​

  • Target: 3-4L water daily (more on tennis/climbing days)
  • Timing: Large glass upon waking, sip throughout day
  • Benefits: Supports metabolism, reduces false hunger, improves performance

Sleep Optimization ​

  • Consistency: Same bedtime/wake time, even weekends
  • Environment: Cool, dark room
  • Pre-bed routine: No screens 1 hour before bed
  • Target: 7-9 hours - crucial for fat loss and recovery

Stress Management ​

  • Impact: High stress = harder fat loss, increased cravings
  • Strategies: Deep breathing, short walks, consistent routine
  • Sports advantage: Tennis/climbing are excellent stress relievers

Meal Timing Considerations ​

  • Pre-tennis: Light carbs 1-2 hours before (banana, toast)
  • Post-workout: Protein within 2 hours (your shakes)
  • Evening: Lighter carbs if fat loss stalls

Social Situations ​

  • Restaurant strategy: Check menus ahead, aim for grilled proteins + vegetables
  • Alcohol: Budget calories if drinking, avoid mixers
  • Weekend planning: Aim for 80% adherence, don't abandon completely

Plateau Breakers (For Later Use) ​

  • Refeed days: One higher calorie day every 2-3 weeks
  • Exercise variation: Add different cardio types (swimming, cycling)
  • Calorie cycling: Higher calories on training days, lower on rest days

Warning Signs to Monitor ​

  • Extreme fatigue: Might need to eat more
  • Strength dropping rapidly: Could be losing muscle too fast
  • Obsessive food thoughts: Take a diet break for a week
  • Injuries: Don't push through pain

Mindset & Expectations ​

Key Mental Shifts:

  • Think systems, not goals: Focus on daily habits vs the scale
  • Expect fluctuations: Weight varies daily - track trends
  • Progress isn't linear: Some weeks will be better than others
  • Non-scale victories: Energy, tennis performance, how clothes fit

Success Principles:

  • Consistency beats perfection
  • Aim for 80-90% adherence vs perfect days followed by derailment
  • Your diet plan and exercise routine drive 99% of results
  • Supplements provide 1% edge at best

Expected Timeline & Results ​

Month 1 (September-October) ​

  • Focus on habit formation
  • Expect 2-3% body fat reduction
  • Energy levels may dip initially
  • Cardio fitness begins improving

Month 2 (October-November) ​

  • Steady progress continues
  • Cardio fitness improves noticeably
  • 2-3% additional body fat loss
  • Strength gains from gym routine

Months 3-4 (November-January) ​

  • Final push to goal
  • May need to adjust calories down slightly
  • Focus on consistency and adherence
  • Tennis/climbing performance should improve

Realistic Expectations:

  • Total Expected Loss: 8-12% body fat
  • Realistic Range: 18-22% final body fat
  • Aggressive Goal: 17% body fat (requires perfect adherence)

Best Investment Priorities ​

  1. Food scale (if you don't have a good one)
  2. Flexify app subscription for tracking
  3. $15 foam roller for recovery
  4. Creatine if you want one supplement that works
  5. Quality water bottle for hydration

Success Key

This plan prioritizes simplicity, minimal food waste, and equipment you already own. Focus on consistency with the fundamentals rather than perfection. Your success will come from daily adherence to the meal plan, progressive overload in the gym, and adding those cardio sessions.
